investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Silveris Ride (ride-hailing); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.141.0.0/16; Billing: a daily charge job 'premium-collection' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'chronos-lite', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (Australia/Sydney); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
